title: Japanese Lassi Pancakes
description: A twist on traditional pancakes, Japanese Lassi Pancakes incorporate the flavors of Japanese cuisine with the creaminess of Indian yogurt.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together warm water, flour, and sugar.
In a separate bowl, whisk together yogurt, lassi, eggs, and melted butter.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
Heat a non-stick pan or griddle over medium heat.
Drop the batter by 1/4 cupfuls onto the pan.
Cook for 2-3 minutes, until bubbles appear on the surface.
Flip and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Serve warm with your favorite toppings.
